outcome_intro: Ask your AI "every meeting we've had with Northwind IT" or "talk-time across last month's QBRs" and get the answer across all your calls at once - not one meeting at a time. Granola records and summarizes each meeting; this skill syncs them into a local, searchable mirror so your agent queries transcripts, summaries, and attendee history across every client conversation.

pain_points: Client context lives in dozens of separate meeting recordings - before a QBR you're scrubbing back through weeks of calls to remember what you promised whom.
The notes all exist, but nobody can answer "what did we tell this client last quarter" without opening every meeting by hand.

different_vs_wrappers: Most meeting-notes integrations answer one question by making one live API call - fine for a single meeting, useless when you need to reason across a quarter of calls. This skill syncs your meetings into a local SQLite mirror you can search by title, notes, and transcript text, so cross-meeting questions - an attendee's whole timeline, talk-time rolled up across dozens of calls, every mention of a topic - resolve as one instant local query your agent can actually read.
different_vs_vendor: Granola's own AI answers questions inside a single meeting; this complements it by making every meeting queryable at once - attendee history, cross-call search, and talk-time aggregation the per-meeting view can't give you.

faqs.a: Yes, on paid ChatGPT plans. ChatGPT connects to remote MCP servers over HTTPS, so you expose the local Granola MCP server via a secure bridge. Step-by-step in the install guide.

faqs.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faqs.a: No. Paste one sentence into Claude Code or Codex and your agent does the install, or run a one-line installer. You enter your credentials once.
Your data stays on your machine. The CLI, MCP server, and the local mirror are all local. The AI sees query results, not raw bulk data, and credentials are never bundled or transmitted by MSP Skills.
Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. You pay only for whichever AI agent you already use.

faqs.q: Do I need a Granola API key?
faqs.a: You need a Granola account. Cross-meeting sync pulls from the Granola public REST API using a Personal or Workspace API key (GRANOLA_API_KEY) from Granola Settings > API; recent Granola desktop versions seal the local cache, so the API key is the supported path. Run granola-cli doctor to confirm auth is working.

faqs.q: Will this replace the Granola app?
faqs.a: No. Keep recording and reviewing meetings in Granola as usual. This skill sits alongside it for the cross-meeting questions the app answers one meeting at a time - attendee timelines, bulk export, talk-time, and topic search across everything you've recorded.

governance_summary: The skill reads your Granola meetings - notes, AI summaries, transcripts, folders, and attendees - into a local mirror and answers questions against it. No command changes or deletes anything in your Granola account. The only writes are local: the mirror itself, the markdown files you export, your saved API key, and the optional Granola MCP sign-in. Let agents run the read and export commands; keep a human on any credential command.
